_about: Plain-language reading of the datamined client data: hero tables from client 1.30.07, skill values and squad rules from the decrypted catalog V202610032200 tables, and English game text from the same catalog. Numbers quoted in tips are the client's displayed values at 5 stars and skill level 30 unless stated.

10005.summary: Fragile Warrior gunner who throws a 4-grenade volley and boosts her own attack.
tips: Grenadier lands on random enemies (up to 8 grenades at 5★), so she is best against full enemy squads, not a single boss.
Caliber Modification gives a flat +28.2% ATK in every fight, so she is one of the SSRs still worth using in PvP.

10006.summary: Awakened Nora (after the antidote questline): the zombie-farming specialist. More resources from resource zombies, and a buff for every squad.
tips: Owning her gives ALL your squads +5% damage to Wild and Rally Monsters, even when she is not deployed.
Put her in the squad that farms Metal, Food and Oil Zombies and Elite Zombie Hordes: her squad gets more Iron Ore, Food and Oil from those kills.
Her skills only work against monsters, so leave her out of PvP squads.

10007.summary: Warrior tank who reduces the damage the whole front row takes.
tips: Field Support cuts the front row's Physical damage taken by up to 30% for 8 seconds, and Tactical Shield adds a permanent 17.7% reduction.
Field Support only blocks Physical damage. Against Radiation-heavy squads (Monroe, Yana, Leah, Lucian, Silas), add Virgilio or Bekka.

10008.summary: Warrior tank built for zombie fights: her roar cuts damage from monsters and her passive raises her DEF.
tips: Her flamethrower fires slowly (one attack every 4 seconds) but hits hard.
Her roar only reduces damage from monsters, so use Arnold or Dirk in PvP.

20005.summary: Tactical archer and cheerleader: her dance raises your back row's damage against monsters.
tips: The stronger your back row, the more her buff is worth. Pair her with Leah, Silas or Katya in zombie events.
Her buff and passive only work against monsters, so bench her for PvP.

20006.summary: Tactical tank whose battle song gives the front row extra DEF (shield) for 6 seconds.
tips: In this game DEF works as a shield that soaks damage until it breaks, so his song adds shield to your front line.
His passive only reduces monster damage. In PvP, Bekka or Virgilio do the job better.

20009.summary: Warrior Molotov thrower with a permanent attack boost and 2-target fire bombs.
tips: His attack boost works in every fight, PvP included.
His battle skill splits damage across 2 random enemies rather than focusing one.

30001.summary: Warrior poison tank whose venom shot hits 2 front enemies and lowers their attack by 6% for 4 seconds.
tips: The -6% ATK works on any enemy, players included.
Her passive only reduces monster damage, so she is mainly a zombie tank.

30003.summary: SSR Aria: a quick-firing rifle and a passive that makes your back-row Warriors hit monsters harder.
tips: In Season 1 she is upgraded to UR Aria (#31003), who replaces her.
Her passive gives back-row Warriors up to +22.9% damage to monsters, a natural fit next to Monroe, Lucian, Rachel and Logan in zombie content.

30004.summary: The hardest-hitting SSR (and the most fragile one): an Assault rocket gunner.
tips: Her phosphorus rounds hit the 2 front enemies, so she shreds tanks.
She has the lowest HP of any SSR, so keep two solid tanks in front of her.

30005.summary: Assault grenadier: 5 grenades per battle skill and extra damage to monsters.
tips: Five random grenades make him one of the best SSRs for clearing zombie waves.
His passive only works against monsters. For PvP, Celeste is the better Assault SSR.

30006.summary: Warrior sniper with an exclusive weapon that grows stronger with every Warrior in the squad.
tips: With her weapon, each of her own critical hits adds a stack of +3% Radiation damage (max 15%). The stack cap equals the number of Warriors in your squad, so fill the squad with Warriors.
At 4 stacks she also fires a Devastating Rocket at 3 enemies.
Her battle skill is available from Hero Lv. 1; everyone else waits until Lv. 5.
Her weapon unlocks earliest in the season (day 3; Leah day 17, Yana day 38).

30007.summary: Assault tank whose grenades slow enemies and whose tactics cut monster damage to the front row.
tips: Tactical Grenade also slows enemies, which buys time against charging zombies.
His damage reduction only works against monsters. For PvP fronts use Vera or Vince.
The client's own table gives Pincer Tactic an impossible value (295% damage reduction at 5★), which looks like a game data error.

30011.summary: SR hero; the claimed gathering bonus is unverified.
tips: Client data lists a Soldier Load benefit for Jackson, Jamal and Hank, but its live gathering effect is unverified. Do not choose them for gathering on this basis.
Survival Expert unlocks at Hero Lv.31 and 4★, increasing ATK, DEF and HP by 5%.

31003.summary: UR Aria: the Season 1 upgrade of SSR Aria, with stronger versions of all her skills.
tips: In Season 1, SSR Aria is upgraded to this UR version and the UR replaces her, so invest knowing she carries over.
Her Barrage Storm is a long channel: about 3,032% ATK in total at 5★ Lv. 30, versus 1,754% for SSR Aria.
Zombie Terminator gives back-row Warriors +25.5% damage to monsters at 5★.

40001.summary: SR hero; the claimed gathering bonus is unverified.
tips: Client data lists a Soldier Load benefit for Jackson, Jamal and Hank, but its live gathering effect is unverified. Do not choose them for gathering on this basis.
Survival Expert unlocks at Hero Lv.31 and 4★, increasing ATK, DEF and HP by 5%.

tips: Client data lists a Soldier Load benefit for Jackson, Jamal and Hank, but its live gathering effect is unverified. Do not choose them for gathering on this basis.
Survival Expert unlocks at Hero Lv.31 and 4★, increasing ATK, DEF and HP by 5%.

40010.summary: Tactical archer whose heavy arrow hits the front enemies and whose passive adds monster damage.
tips: A budget back-row filler for Tactical zombie squads until your UR Tactical heroes are starred.
Her passive only works against monsters.

50001.summary: Warrior UR tank: his shout adds DEF (shield) to the front row and his armor cuts all damage he takes.
tips: Heavy Armor reduces ALL damage he takes by up to 30.3%, so he holds up in PvP.
Iron Will gives the front row up to +50.5% DEF (shield) for 10 seconds. Pair him with Arnold: Dirk adds shield while Arnold reduces damage.

50002.summary: The only Support hero: he raises the whole squad's attack and makes everyone's skills recharge faster.
tips: Hawkeye raises ALL allies' ATK by up to 16.8% for 8 seconds, and Sheriff speeds up skill cooldowns by up to 30.3%. None of it depends on faction or enemy type.
Sheriff also cuts the damage your highest-attack ally takes by up to 12.2%, so build your main damage dealer first.
His own battle skill recharges slowly (12.3 seconds), which his cooldown-speed passive offsets.

50003.summary: The highest attack in the game and the lowest HP of any UR: an all-in Warrior damage dealer.
tips: Tesla Coil arcs between 5 random enemies, and Frankenstein adds up to 30.3% Crit Rate.
He has the lowest HP of any UR, so keep Arnold or Dirk in front of him.

50004.summary: The tankiest hero in the game. Her sonic grenade hits all enemies and weakens their Radiation attacks.
tips: Ion Shield cuts the Radiation damage she takes by up to 40.6%, and Sonic Boom lowers ALL enemies' Radiation damage by 15.3% for 5 seconds.
She is the hard counter to Radiation damage dealers (Monroe, Yana, Leah, Lucian, Silas). With Virgilio she makes a near Radiation-proof front line.

50005.summary: Tactical tank who shields the whole squad from Radiation damage and toughens the front row.
tips: Magnetic Coil lowers Radiation damage taken by ALL allies by up to 20.4% for 8 seconds.
Magnetic Armor gives the front row 13.5% less damage and another 13.5% less Radiation damage.

50006.summary: Tactical sniper whose helicopter hits every enemy. Her exclusive weapon scales with Tactical heroes.
tips: With her weapon she starts each battle with 2 stacks of +3% Radiation damage per Tactical hero (max 10), and gains up to +100% attack speed as she lands hits.
Her weapon also makes her fire her battle skill at 2 front enemies the moment battle starts.
Her weapon unlocks on season day 17.

50007.summary: Tactical damage dealer whose spider robot dives the enemy back row, with a 20% chance to stun.
tips: His spider robot hits 3 back-row enemies for up to 934% ATK, with a 20% chance to stun.
Overload gives him a flat +40.5% ATK, the biggest self-buff in the roster.

50008.summary: Tactical machine-gunner whose toxin rounds strip up to 25% of the target's DEF.
tips: Viper fires 20 neurotoxin rounds (at 5★), each stripping 5% DEF up to -25% for 9 seconds.
DEF is the enemy's shield, so shredding it helps every hit your squad lands. War Machine adds +30.2% Physical damage.

50009.summary: Assault tank who hits back: in Guard state she counter-attacks every time she is hit.
tips: Portable Sentry puts her in Guard for up to 8.8 seconds: she counter-attacks every time she is hit (at most once per second). At 4★ the Guard also covers the front row.
Sentinel cuts front-row damage taken by up to 13.2%, doubled for Assault heroes while she is on Guard, so field her with Vince and Jack.

50010.summary: Assault tank who taunts the enemy front row and lowers their attack for 8 seconds.
tips: Glaring Taunt pulls aggro from up to 4 front-row enemies and cuts their ATK by 16.8% for 8 seconds.
Mountain Ranger reduces all damage he takes by up to 30.3%, so he works in PvP too.

50011.summary: Assault lightning caster who hits the 3 back-row enemies; her exclusive weapon adds stacking Radiation burn.
tips: With her weapon, her hits apply Overload Charge, which burns for 3% of her ATK per second for 30 seconds. The stack cap is 3 per Assault hero in the squad.
Her weapon upgrades her auto attack at weapon Lv. 1 and her battle skill at Lv. 10 and Lv. 30, so weapon shards are her main upgrade path once she is 5★.
Her weapon unlocks last in the season (day 38).

50012.summary: Assault finisher: his SMG always targets the enemy with the lowest HP percentage.
tips: His SMG always targets the enemy with the lowest HP percentage, so he finishes wounded enemies.
Mechanic adds up to 30.3% Crit Rate. Pair him with heroes that hit everyone (Nicole, Yana).

50013.summary: Assault grenadier whose firepower net hits every enemy, with a passive that boosts Physical damage.
tips: Fine Firepower Net hits ALL enemies for up to 716% ATK, one of only three battle skills that hit the whole enemy squad (with Leah and Bekka).
Actuary adds +30.3% Physical damage, so Katya's DEF shred pairs well with her.

global.title: Fill the squad with one faction
global.body: A squad has 5 heroes. Heroes from the same faction unlock a bonus to HP, ATK and DEF: 3 of one faction gives +5%, 3 plus 2 of another faction +10%, 4 of one faction +15%, and all 5 +20%.

global.title: Know the counter triangle
global.body: Warrior beats Assault, Assault beats Tactical, Tactical beats Warrior. When your faction counters theirs, your heroes take 20% less damage from them. The game's battle report tells you whether your lineup counters the enemy or is countered.

global.title: Tanks in front, damage in back
global.body: A squad has 2 front-row and 3 back-row slots. Frontline heroes have the HP and DEF to absorb hits, so the game tells you to put them in front. Backline heroes deal the damage from behind. Carter (Support) belongs in the back row.

global.title: Many SSRs only shine against zombies
global.body: About half of the SSR heroes have skills that only work against monsters ("damage to monsters", "damage from monsters"). They are great for zombies, rallies and events but weak in PvP. Rachel, Logan and Celeste have boosts that work everywhere.

global.title: DEF is a shield
global.body: The game describes DEF as a shield that absorbs most damage until it breaks. DEF buffs (Conan, Dirk) add shield; Katya breaks shields faster; damage-reduction passives (Arnold, Dirk, Vince, Virgilio) keep working after the shield is gone.

global.title: Physical vs Radiation
global.body: There are two damage types. Radiation dealers: Monroe, Leah, Yana, Lucian, Silas, Celeste and Carter (plus Conan's and Jack's auto attacks). Everyone else deals Physical damage. Bekka and Virgilio cut Radiation damage; Arnold's Field Support only blocks Physical damage. A front line with both covers you either way.

global.title: Exclusive weapons are huge
global.body: A level-30 exclusive weapon adds about 703k HP, 8.4k ATK, 4.2k DEF and 5% damage resistance to its hero. That is more HP than levelling the hero to 150. It also raises skill caps from 30 to 40. Upgrading it gives every hero up to +40k HP, +800 ATK and +200 DEF, so weapon shards help your whole roster.

global.title: 4★ unlocks a big stat talent
global.body: At Hero Lv. 31 and 4★ the 4th slot unlocks a permanent talent: UR heroes get Doomsday Judgment (+20% HP, ATK and DEF, +10% skill cooldown speed), SSR heroes get Wasteland Wanderer (+10%), and SR heroes Survival Expert (+5%). Pushing a hero to 4★ is one of the biggest single upgrades.

global.title: Raise stars before skill books
global.body: Star level caps skill level: 1★ → Lv. 1, 2★ → 5, 3★ → 10, 4★ → 20, 5★ → 30. Stars also multiply skill damage (for example Monroe's sniper shot: 70% ATK at 0★, 486% at 5★). Books beyond the cap are wasted, so star a hero up first. Going from 0 to 5 stars takes 975 shards.

global.title: UR heroes start faster
global.body: UR heroes get about 27–46% more HP, ATK and DEF from levels 1–50. From Lv. 65 every hero gains the same from levelling, and the hero's own base stats make the difference. Troop command rises from 52 at Lv. 1 to 351 at Lv. 150.

global.title: SR gathering bonus is unverified
global.body: Client data lists a Soldier Load benefit for Jackson, Jamal and Hank, but its live gathering effect is unverified. Do not choose them for gathering on this basis.
